# Green & Clean — Waste Management in Kerala

> Eco-friendly, compliant waste management for salons, offices and homes across all 14 districts of Kerala, India. Non-medical waste only. In association with Green 360-N.E.R.T. Motto: "There is no Planet B".

- Phone: +91 62823 05350

## Pages

- [Home](https://greenanclean.com/): Overview, how it works, waste we collect, districts served, testimonials, FAQ
- [Services](https://greenanclean.com/services): Salon waste management; general & commercial waste (plastic, paper, metal, wood, textile, dry, cafeteria); residential waste & composting bins with inoculum solution
- [About](https://greenanclean.com/about): Over a decade of experience; segregated bins, scheduled pickup, chemical & organic waste disposal, monthly reports
- [Contact](https://greenanclean.com/contact): Book a pickup or free consultation

## Notes

- Medical / biomedical waste is not accepted.
- Serves Thiruvananthapuram, Kollam, Pathanamthitta, Alappuzha, Kottayam, Idukki, Ernakulam, Thrissur, Palakkad, Malappuram, Kozhikode, Wayanad, Kannur and Kasaragod.
